categories.label: ASR Model
categories.description: Speech-to-text model family used for command recognition, dictation, and conversational transcription.
categories.implementation_notes: Common implementations combine front-end audio preprocessing, acoustic modeling, language modeling, and post-processing tuned for streaming or offline scenarios.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw during the ASR test run.

metrics.label: Latency
metrics.definition: Recognition response delay from audio input to final result.

metrics.label: Accuracy-en
metrics.definition: English recognition accuracy under the current benchmark set.

metrics.label: Accuracy-cn
metrics.definition: Chinese recognition accuracy under the current benchmark set.

metrics.label: Accuracy-es
metrics.definition: Spanish recognition accuracy under the current benchmark set.

metrics.label: Accuracy-total
metrics.definition: Overall aggregated ASR accuracy across supported evaluation sets.

categories.label: TTS
categories.description: Text-to-speech model family used for voice playback, assistant prompts, and spoken UI output.
categories.implementation_notes: Typical stacks combine text normalization, acoustic generation, and neural vocoder components, with tuning between naturalness, throughput, and on-device resource usage.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw during TTS inference.

metrics.label: Latency
metrics.definition: Speech synthesis delay from text request to audible output start.

metrics.label: Accuracy-en
metrics.definition: English synthesis quality score or proxy benchmark score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-cn
metrics.definition: Chinese synthesis quality score or proxy benchmark score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-es
metrics.definition: Spanish synthesis quality score or proxy benchmark score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-total
metrics.definition: Overall aggregated TTS quality score across supported evaluation sets.

categories.label: Translation
categories.description: Text translation model family for multilingual translation quality and throughput comparison.
categories.implementation_notes: Implementations usually rely on multilingual encoders and decoders with domain tuning, terminology constraints, and serving optimizations for batch or real-time translation.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw during translation inference.

metrics.label: Latency
metrics.definition: End-to-end translation response delay for the configured test case.

metrics.label: Accuracy-en to cn
metrics.definition: English to Chinese translation accuracy or quality score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-cn to en
metrics.definition: Chinese to English translation accuracy or quality score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-en to es
metrics.definition: English to Spanish translation accuracy or quality score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-es to en
metrics.definition: Spanish to English translation accuracy or quality score.

metrics.label: Accuracy-total
metrics.definition: Overall aggregated translation quality across configured language directions.

categories.label: VoiceCallTranslation Solution
categories.description: Full voice-call translation solution integrating ASR, translation, and TTS in one streaming workflow.
categories.implementation_notes: These solutions typically orchestrate multiple model stages in real time, so pipeline coordination, buffering strategy, and stage latency balancing strongly affect user experience.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw across the end-to-end voice call translation workflow.

metrics.label: E2E Latency
metrics.definition: Total pipeline latency from source speech input to translated speech output.

metrics.label: Accuracy-en to cn
metrics.definition: English to Chinese translation quality within the full voice-call solution.

metrics.label: Accuracy-cn to en
metrics.definition: Chinese to English translation quality within the full voice-call solution.

metrics.label: Accuracy-total
metrics.definition: Overall user-facing quality score for the full voice-call translation pipeline.

categories.label: LPI Recording
categories.description: Low-power idle or always-on audio recording scenario focused on battery-sensitive capture workloads.
categories.implementation_notes: Implementations usually emphasize DSP offload, low-duty-cycle wakeups, and data path simplification to minimize steady-state energy cost.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw while the low-power recording pipeline remains active.

categories.label: Multi Model Detection
categories.description: Multi-trigger or multi-model detection stack for wake word, event detection, or front-end sensing workloads.
categories.implementation_notes: Common implementations chain lightweight detectors with policy logic to balance responsiveness, false accept rate, and compute cost under continuous listening constraints.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.definition: Average platform power draw while all detection models are active.

metrics.label: Latency
metrics.definition: Detection response delay from trigger condition to final decision.

metrics.label: Wakeup Rate
metrics.definition: Successful wakeup or detection rate under the configured benchmark.
